decision: Accept the fixed within-head V/O representation as numerically valid positive layer-1 oracle evidence. The fp64 decomposition with fp32 runtime factors preserves all 32 source Q/K head patterns, achieves strict total-rank compression and at least 98 percent operator energy, and passes both held-out quality gates. Do not certify Phase 3: no factors are installed, the quality diagnostic still uses the exact source MLP, and physical host runtime, memory, autonomous generation, and end-to-end gates remain unmeasured. Authorize an installable layer-1 factorized-attention design and a preregistered compact residual-path oracle behind that attention.
claim_boundary: Positive numerically stable within-head V/O layer-1 oracle evidence only; no factors installed or promoted and no physical runtime, model, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
